title: ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #1: ಕೆಲಸ ತೋರಿಸಿ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಮತ | Show me the work, then my vote #Shorts
description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ, ಸಂಚಿಕೆ 1. ಐದು ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ಮನೆ ಬಾಗಿಲಿಗೆ ಬರುವ ನಾಯಕ, ಉಡುಗೊರೆ ಚೀಲ, ಉಚಿತ ಯೋಜನೆಗಳು, ಮತ್ತು ಅದರ ಬಿಲ್ ಯಾರು ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತಾರೆ? ಕೆಲಸ ತೋರಿಸಿ, ಆಮೇಲೆ ಮತ.

Mallanna Asks, episode 1. A politician who visits once every five years, a bag of gifts, free schemes, and the question: who pays the bill? (Fictional characters; every figure is real.)
- Rs 375.61 crore of cash, liquor, gold and gifts was seized in Karnataka's 2023 election, 4.5 times 2018 (Election Commission).
- Giving or taking anything for a vote is a crime for both: up to one year in jail or a fine (Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, sections 170 and 173). A promise of public policy is not bribery.
- The five guarantee schemes cost Rs 51,286 crore in the 2026-27 budget (PRS). The revenue account went from a Rs 13,496 crore surplus in 2022-23 to a Rs 25,449 crore deficit in 2025-26, and the state owes contractors Rs 36,136 crore. 59% of revenue goes on salaries, pensions and interest.
- MLAs' basic pay: Rs 25,000 to Rs 80,000 (2022 and 2025). The 81 MLAs re-elected in 2023: average declared assets from Rs 39.7 crore to Rs 69.4 crore.
Free schemes are a legal policy choice. Cash for votes is a crime. Both cost you.

What work has your MLA shown you? Tell us in the comments. Look them up: https://jarvisss007.github.io/know-your-mla

Sources: Election Commission figures, 8 May 2023 (Business Today, Udayavani); Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023; PRS Legislative Research, Karnataka Budget Analysis 2026-27; Karnataka Finance Department note, 17 Sept 2026; Legislative Assembly records; MLAs' sworn affidavits (ADR / myneta.info).
Every figure comes from a public record. If one is wrong, tell us and we will correct it.

title: ಎತ್ತಿನಹೊಳೆ: ₹15,297 ಕೋಟಿ ಖರ್ಚು, ಕೋಲಾರಕ್ಕೆ ನೀರಿಲ್ಲ | Yettinahole: Rs 15,297 cr #Shorts
description:
ಎತ್ತಿನಹೊಳೆ ಕುಡಿಯುವ ನೀರಿನ ಯೋಜನೆ: ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 2024ರ ವೇಳೆಗೆ ₹15,297 ಕೋಟಿ ಖರ್ಚು. 12 ವರ್ಷವಾದರೂ ಯೋಜನೆ ಕಾರ್ಯಾರಂಭ ಮಾಡಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂದು ಸಿಎಜಿ ವರದಿ. ಕೋಲಾರ, ಚಿಕ್ಕಬಳ್ಳಾಪುರಕ್ಕೆ ಇನ್ನೂ ನೀರು ತಲುಪಿಲ್ಲ.

Yettinahole drinking water project: Rs 15,297 crore spent by March 2024, and the national auditor (CAG) found it "could not be made operational even after 12 years". Its water has still not reached Kolar and Chikkaballapura; the government's own target is the end of 2027. Approved at Rs 8,324 crore in 2012, revised to Rs 23,252 crore in 2023. No project report ever fixed a completion date. 80% of works were awarded without checking whether bidders could do the job; 67% of the work by value went to seven contractors. By August 2026, 20 of 54 work packages were complete. Every government since 2012, BJP, Congress and coalition, has run it.

Sources: CAG performance audit of the Yettinahole project (Report No. 10, tabled January 2026); Karnataka government statement, 20 August 2026; Chief Minister's 2027 target.

title: 97% of Karnataka's MLAs are crorepatis. 36 doubled their wealth in one term #Shorts
description:
97% of Karnataka's MLAs are crorepatis: 204 of the 210 whose affidavits are archived. The middle MLA declares about Rs 18 crore, and 29 declare more than Rs 100 crore. The 81 MLAs who won in both 2018 and 2023 saw average declared assets rise from Rs 39.7 crore to Rs 69.4 crore in one term; 36 of them at least doubled their wealth. To be fair, much of the rise is land they already owned, now valued higher, which is legal. And it is the same in every party.

Check your own MLA's sworn affidavit: https://jarvisss007.github.io/know-your-mla

July 2021, BJP government: the contractors association alleged commissions of up to 40% in a letter to the PMO. description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #8: ಯಾರೂ ಜೈಲಿಗೆ ಯಾಕೆ ಹೋಗಲ್ಲ?

195 Lokayukta cases (Sept 2022-Feb 2026), 0 verdicts. The old ACB: 19 convictions from 2,000+ cases. Janardhan Reddy (BJP) convicted May 2025 after about 15 years, conviction suspended in 5 weeks; Satish Sail (Congress) sentenced Oct 2024, suspended within 3 weeks; both still MLAs, appeals pending. But exposure works: in 2011 a sitting CM resigned days after the Lokayukta report (B.S. Yediyurappa, later acquitted or cases quashed). 30% of MLAs skipped the annual asset statement (Nov 2025); the only penalty is publication of names. What you can do: RTI (Rs 10), a Lokayukta complaint (anyone), read your MLA's affidavit (free).

title: ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #9: ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ | North and South #Shorts
description:
ಮಲ್ಲಣ್ಣ ಕೇಳ್ತಾನೆ #9: ಉತ್ತರ ಮತ್ತು ದಕ್ಷಿಣ

Namma Metro Phase 2: approved at Rs 26,405 crore in 2014 (due 2020), revised to Rs 40,425 crore in May 2025, last section now due 2027; top fare Rs 60 to Rs 90 (Feb 2025). Kalyana Karnataka board, 7 districts, 2013-14 to 2024-25: Rs 19,778 crore allocated, Rs 13,229 crore released, Rs 11,174 crore spent (state figures). CAG: Rs 387.52 crore of assistance lost because funds went unused (the government disputes this), 3,731 works worth Rs 738.65 crore cancelled. Income per person grew 47.96% in Kalaburagi vs 74.84% statewide (2013-14 to 2019-20). Yadgir has the highest child anaemia in the state (76%). To be fair: Article 371J (2013) gave the region reserved jobs, seats and its own board. Metro costs are shared by the Centre, the state and loans.
